import hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
doc,result,site=map(Path,sys.argv[1:])
body=doc.read_text()
page=site.read_text()
pairs=[('up to 20 data rows per excerpt','up to 20 data rows across both excerpts, plus their headers','at most 20 data rows across both excerpts, plus their headers'),('jusqu’à 20 lignes de données par extrait','jusqu’à 20 lignes de données au total, en plus des en-têtes','au plus 20 lignes de données au total, en plus des en-têtes')]
for old,new,source in pairs:
    assert source in page and body.count(old)==1
    body=body.replace(old,new)
doc.write_text(body)
data=json.loads(result.read_text())
data['source_sha256'][doc.name]=hashlib.sha256(doc.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
data['source_sha256'][str(site)]=hashlib.sha256(site.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
data['offer_cap_verified_against_candidate']='20 data rows total, plus headers'
result.write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+'\n')
print(data['offer_cap_verified_against_candidate'])
